name: Roeterseiland (UvA)
description: Roeterseiland is an open city campus of the University of Amsterdam. Its postwar megastructure was renewed by Allford Hall Monaghan Morris: a four-storey opening reconnects the Nieuwe Achtergracht canal and campus, beneath the glazed event space De Brug and research offices. A separate pedestrian bridge leads into the shared entrance between buildings A and B. Building A houses the law faculty.
